title: Student Worker
bio: Amber Nolazco-Torres (she/her) is a senior at Harvard College in Currier House, concentrating in Government with a secondary in Ethnicity, Migration, and Rights. Originally from Newark in the San Francisco Bay Area, her family roots are in Sinaloa, Mexico. As president of Harvard-Radcliffe Raza, she celebrates and uplifts Mexican culture on campus. Passionate about educational equity, she mentors through the Radcliffe Institute’s Emerging Leaders Program. In her role with the Harvard Foundation, she strives to foster a welcoming and inclusive community for all students. Amber also loves coffee and serves as a manager at Cabot Café.
